theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (V : Set (Euclid P)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn V n) (τ : Fin n → Euclid P), 1 ≤ n → IsOpen V → Orthonormal ℝ τ → IsIntegerMultiplicity S → BoundaryVanishes S → S.support ⊆ (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ) : Set (Euclid P)) → IsConnected (V ∩ (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ) : Set (Euclid P))) → ∃ c : ℤ, (∀ ω : TestFormOn V n, S ω = (c : ℝ) * ∫ x in V ∩ (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ) : Set (Euclid P)), (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x τ ∂μHE[n]) ∧ ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → W ⊆ V → S.massOn W = (c.natAbs : ℝ≥0∞) * μHE[n] (W ∩ (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range τ) : Set (Euclid P)))
